---
title: "LAMP Assay Setup for Rapid Pathogen Detection"
description: "Loop-mediated isothermal amplification for rapid, field-deployable detection of foodborne pathogens."
date: 2026-08-13
categories: [Detection, Molecular]
---

**Scope.** Setup and execution of loop-mediated isothermal amplification
(LAMP) assays for rapid detection of foodborne pathogens, including the
*Clostridium perfringens* assay developed in our lab
([Chaudhary et al. 2024](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.japr.2024.100513),
[2025](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.japr.2025.100600)).

::: {.callout-note}
## Full write-up in preparation
The complete step-by-step procedure — primer design, reaction setup,
incubation, and result interpretation — is being finalized for publication
here. Until then, [email us](mailto:l.zhang@msstate.edu) for the current
working version.
:::
